Text:
VASCULAR SURGERY

Antimicrobial prophylaxis is not recommended for some procedures, including brachiocephalic procedures (e.g., carotid endarterectomy, brachial artery repair) without implantation of prosthetic material.

Antimicrobial prophylaxis is recommended in vascular procedures that involve implantation of prosthetic material and procedures for which there is greater risk of infection, such as aneurysm repair, thromboendarterectomy and vein bypass. Longer duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis therapy is warranted for graft placement.

Therapy:
## Prophylaxis for vascular procedures OTHER THAN graft placement* and procedures involving the groin** (see below for graft placement and involving groin)

## Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative for beta-lactam allergy or MRSA colonization:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

## *Prophylaxis for graft placement procedures:

## Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

Post-op prophylaxis include q8h x2doses.

Please plase post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

## Alternative for beta lactam allergy or MRSA colonization:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

Post-op prophylaxis include q12h x1dose.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis order after admission.

## Rifampin vascular graft soak for INFECTED graft

Rifampin Vascular Graft Soak (600mg)

## **Prophylaxis for procedures that involve the abdominal aorta or groin incision due to the potential for gastrointestinal flora:

## Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative for beta lactam allergy:

Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment

Vancomycin 15mg/kg weight based dosing + Gentamicin 5mg/kg weight based dosing

## Alternative for MRSA colonization:

Cefazolin weight based dosing + Vancomycin 15mg/kg weight based dosing
